name: Bilt Blue Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR varies with the U.S. Prime Rate: Prime + 19.99% to 27.99% (Prime 6.75% as of 2026-01-14), maximum 35.99%. A 10.00% introductory APR applies to new card purchases for the first 12 billing cycles after account opening. Balance transfer APR 26.74% to 34.74%; cash advance APR 31.74% to 34.74%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee — the foreign transaction fee is listed as "None" in the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure.

credit_required.notes: Approval decisions are made by the issuing bank based on credit profile; Bilt does not publish minimum score requirements. No credit score impact to apply and see if approved.

rewards.redemption_notes: Bilt Points redeemable via 28 airline and hotel transfer partners (1:1 ratio), the Bilt Travel Portal, future rent or mortgage payments, Lyft rides, fitness classes, statement credits, eligible student loan payments, and toward a home down payment. Category rates are the headline totals published by Bilt and are inclusive of the Bilt loyalty membership and the Bilt Card multiplier earn; Bilt partner restaurant rates are "up to" and vary by restaurant. Under Housing-only rewards the housing multiplier (0.5X to 1.25X) is set each billing cycle from everyday spend relative to the housing payment, with a 250-point floor.

signup_bonus.description: $100 in Bilt Cash credited to the Bilt account upon approval — no spend requirement. Bilt Cash is a dollar-denominated Bilt rewards credit redeemable at Bilt partner merchants and toward housing point unlocks; it expires December 31 each year with up to $100 carried over.

benefits.title: No transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA
benefits.description: Earn rewards on rent, mortgage and HOA payments made through Bilt with no transaction fee. Pay via ACH (account and routing number), Venmo, PayPal, or a mailed check to bypass landlord or servicer card fees. Bilt Card 2.0 has no transaction minimum to earn on housing.

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: Purchases made outside the U.S. carry no foreign transaction fee; the foreign transaction fee is listed as "None" in the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure.

benefits.title: Bilt Neighborhood Dining bonus points
benefits.description: At Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants (20,000+ participating locations) you earn bonus Bilt Points per dollar on top of the card's standard earn rate, up to 4X in total on the Blue Card. The bonus varies by restaurant and is shown in the Bilt app at the time of visit. No activation required.

benefits.title: Lyft bonus points
benefits.description: Linking Bilt and Lyft accounts earns an additional 2X Bilt Points per dollar on eligible rides; combined with the 1X everyday base rate, Blue cardholders earn 3X total on Lyft. Uncapped.

benefits.title: Bilt Travel Portal bonus points
benefits.description: Booking through the Bilt Travel Portal earns +2X on hotels and +1X on flights in bonus Bilt Points on top of the card's base rate — 3X total on hotels and 2X total on flights.

benefits.title: 28 airline and hotel transfer partners
benefits.description: Bilt Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio to Bilt's 28 airline and hotel transfer partners, including major domestic and international airline programs and leading hotel loyalty programs.

benefits.title: Cellular Wireless Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for covered damage or theft of your cellphone.

details.conditions: See the Bilt Blue Card Guide to Benefits.

benefits.title: Purchase Assurance
benefits.description: Mastercard Purchase Assurance coverage for eligible purchases.

details.conditions: See the Bilt Blue Card Guide to Benefits.

benefits.title: MasterRental Coverage
benefits.description: Reimbursement for covered damage or theft to your rental car.

details.conditions: See the Bilt Blue Card Guide to Benefits.

benefits.title: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: Mastercard ID Theft Protection monitors for possible identity theft and provides resolution services. Enrollment is required to receive the benefit.

details.conditions: Enroll at mastercardus.idprotectiononline.com; see the Bilt Blue Card Guide to Benefits.

benefits.title: World Elite Mastercard benefits
benefits.description: As a World Elite Mastercard, the Bilt Blue Card includes Mastercard Travel & Lifestyle Services and other World Elite Mastercard benefits per the card's Guide to Benefits.

other: World Elite Mastercard Travel & Lifestyle Services

notes: Bilt Card 2.0 base card, verified 2026-10-21 against bilt.com/card/blue, the bilt.com/card comparison table, the Bilt Cards Rates & Fees disclosure and the Bilt Card Offer Terms. Issued by Column N.A., Member FDIC and serviced by Cardless, Inc.; a World Elite Mastercard. This record replaces the legacy Wells Fargo Bilt Card (us-wells-fargo-bilt), which is discontinued. Bilt Card 2.0 has three tiers: Bilt Blue (this record, $0 annual fee), Bilt Obsidian (us-column-bilt-obsidian, $95/year) and Bilt Palladium (us-column-bilt-palladium, $495/year). All three tiers charge no transaction fee on housing and no foreign transaction fee. APR is the Prime-based variable range published in the Rates & Fees disclosure, with a 10.00% introductory APR for the first 12 billing cycles on new card purchases. Welcome offer is $100 in Bilt Cash with no spend requirement. Category rates are the headline totals published by Bilt, inclusive of the Bilt loyalty membership and the card multiplier earn; Bilt partner restaurant rates are "up to" and vary by restaurant.
